description: Organised campus events for students and staff as a student volunteer. Planned Iftar Mahfil gatherings during Ramadan, plus educational picnics and study tours. Led a volunteer team, managed event budgets, and worked with faculty and students to shape each event around what the community wanted.

Organised school events that brought students and alumni together. Planned annual Iftar gatherings and class get-togethers, managed event budgets, coordinated volunteer teams, and handled last-minute issues on the day so each event ran smoothly.
